This period at a glance

Auto-generated from the data currently loaded and filtered above

Between 2026-07-29 and 2026-09-01, the kitchens logged 150 complaints against 12,136 units sold — a blended rate of 1.24%. Al-Rehab Kitchen ran hottest at 1.40%, while Plus Mall Kitchen was lowest at 1.16%. Product Quality was the leading complaint category (36% of tickets), most often flagged as "Wrong Item" (17 tickets). Creamy Beef Stroganoff Meal was the most persistent recurring issue, complained about on 3 of the 35 day(s) in this window. (37 tickets had no product named on them and are excluded from product-level figures.)
